author: ETA PRIME
description:
We are back with the all-new OneXPlayer Super V tablet to see what kind of 1800p gaming performance we can get out of it! Powered by the new Intel Panther Lake Core Ultra 358H CPU and the Intel Arc B390 iGPU, this 14-inch AMOLED device is putting down way more performance than expected. I cranked the TDP up to 65W on wall power to really let this chip stretch its legs across games like Cyberpunk 2077, Red Dead Redemption 2, and Crimson Desert.
